overview: An evil spirit lives in an apartment building, where one floor once completely burned down. After the tragedy, local residents begin to feel the presence of an evil force, which becomes the source of more and more troubles. The burnt floor was closed, the button in the elevator was pressed out. It is impossible to get on it unless the spirit wants it. Three friends decide to take a ride on the elevator as a bet - so a simple prank turns into a nightmare when one of them gets stuck on that ill-fated floor.
title: Четвёртый

overview: "Saints" is a travel show in which a young Orthodox blogger will try to repeat the exploits of Seraphim of Sarov, Nil of Sor, Ksenia of St. Petersburg and other saints. Host Seraphim Sashliev will have to go through many tests, from hand-feeding a bear to cutting his head bald. The goal of the project is to find recipes for a fulfilling life today in the exploits of the Saints. This project is about people who managed to become better themselves. The discovery of God inspired them to develop useful qualities in themselves, and allowed them to live in joy and resilience to what was happening around them. Each issue features permanent experts - a psychologist and a priest.
title: Святые

overview: A new social project that will tell real stories about how animals came to the aid of people and saved their lives. You will see dozens of the most unusual rescue stories that will once again remind people that animals are truly the most devoted and selfless friends.
title: Лучший друг человека

overview: Miss Guided follows Becky Freeley, a woman working as a guidance counselor at the Glen Ellen High School which she once attended. She tries to help guide the students so that they will cope with high school better than she did. She also interacts with other teachers and Principal Huffy.
title: Miss Guided

overview: The show "New Day" is designed to make the most cherished dreams of TV viewers come true. A whole army of experts is at their service. In the new season, Sasha Shankara, together with the show's team, will help the heroines accept themselves and radically transform themselves.
title: Новый день

overview: Health is the most important thing in each of our lives! How to eat right? Why is sugar dangerous? What do mothers need to know about their children's health, especially infants? How to cope with seasonal allergies, because spring is just around the corner! To help, we're launching a new program, "Health Secrets," with Anna Demidovich and Dr. Ekaterina Yuryeva! In each episode, we'll discuss pressing health issues and share helpful life hacks and tips. Many important topics await you!
title: Секреты здоровья

overview: A culinary talk show in which guest stars come to Laysan Utyasheva's studio, discuss funny incidents, get nostalgic and cook a favorite dish from the guest's childhood.
title: Вкусно с Ляйсан

overview: Follow the lives and romantic pursuits of four high school boys, who all have no experience with romance.
title: Haru wa Mijikashi Koiseyo Danshi

overview: The series, which emphasizes its story with the football philosophy under the slogan "Life is similar to football," narrates the emotionally charged story of the famous footballer Yasin, who wins the hearts of millions with his goals in every match, and Yeşil, who challenges his fate.
title: Bir Sevdadır

overview: "Honestly" is a sitcom about a modern couple in love who live in a civil marriage. According to the plot, Andrey and Inga, played by Igor Lastochkin and Daria Petrozhytska, are in a constant gender battle and involve their parents, relatives, friends, work colleagues, and their own alter egos in their battles. However, even with their help, the protagonists do not always manage to resolve conflicts. Andriy and Inga continue to knock down their knees, debunk and accept stereotypes, and stay together despite everything.
title: Якщо чесно

overview: A story centered around a woman who, after a certain incident, vows never to fall in love again. However, by chance, she ends up living in a luxury penthouse together with a group of young male celebrities, who each have their own quirks.
title: Celebrity Danshi wa Te ni Oemasen

overview: An entertaining revenge drama follows Haibara Shoko, an ordinary high school girl who vows revenge after all of her family and friends are taken from her. Shoko, an ordinary high school girl, became an internet celebrity after she appeared in beauty streamer Tokumichi Hitoshi's video. However, her classmates, who are jealous of her success, lure her into a trap and film her being assaulted. As a result, the video goes viral and is spread across the internet - making her a target of hate.
title: Kesenai "Watashi": Fukushu no Rensa

overview: Haunted tells the story of Detective Frank Taylor, who dies two years after the abduction of his son. While investigating a case in which a young boy and his baby-sitter are kidnapped, he faces their abductor, a sinister criminal named Simon. Their encounter leaves Simon dead and Frank nearly so... while in the hospital his soul leaves his body and he can see spirits. When he is revived by the doctors, he continues work as a private investigator, but finds that he can receive messages from beyond the grave from kind spirits. He will use this ability to do good and solve cases, but the vengeful Simon is out to make sure he doesn't get the messages... "Dead Men Do Tell Tales..."
title: Haunted

overview: They promise life-long romance, yet they scheme, scam and swindle. Some steal a fortune; others lead double lives. They are Love Rats. The victims at the centre of these cases reveal how they were left with broken hearts and empty bank accounts.
title: Love Rats

overview: First Move with Julia Chatterley will take on a broad palate, covering news, finance, business, technology, AI, art, travel, fashion, sports & entertainment. It will also continue to explore the frontier science, cutting-edge technologies and innovations driving 21st century societies, while analyzing their impact on the climate, health, wealth and geopolitical competition.
title: First Move with Julia Chatterley

overview: Join Melbourne chef Guy Grossi and Maeve O'Meara on an Australia-wide journey to discover more about Italian food and culture, as well as how traditional recipes and techniques are still used worldwide.
title: Italian Food Safari

overview: Legendary comedian Dennis Miller introduces us to the colorful characters who made commercials so much fun. It's a nostalgic and poignant look back at the years when infomercials ruled late-night TV. You'll see revealing interviews with infomercial stars like Tony Robbins, Suzanne Somers, Leeza Gibbons, Kevin Harrington, Brooke Burke, Melissa Rivers, Billy Blanks, and even the Shamwow Guy!
title: The Infomercials That Sold Us

overview: 16 Quebec celebrities try to create alliances and avoid eviction in order to win the season of Big Brother Celebrities.
title: Big Brother Célébrités

overview: Inspired by the real-life story of Samantha Daniels, a New York divorce attorney who is also a high-end matchmaker. The show deals with Kate Fox juggling her job as a divorce lawyer and her burgeoning hobby of finding the perfect match for others. She must deal with pressure from her father, whose law firm she works for, who wants her to focus on her day job instead of her frivolous pursuit of matchmaking. And somewhere in between, perhaps she can find a little happiness in her own personal life when she meets a possible match for herself.
title: Miss Match

overview: Have you ever heard of "Zendaya" application? It's a social networking app that rules every post to contain only positive content. This limitation from the app concept making it less popular until the hottest villain in Thailand, FeungNakhon, registered and posted the first message saying, "let's pass on the positive energy to each other". Zendaya is attacked by a lot of Thai users and immediately becomes widespread, to the point of shaking Zendaya's small office in Silicon Valley. Kommata, the poor Thai employee intending to return to Thailand for vacation has to sit back, curl up, and take care of the app that suddenly becomes popular. Moreover, who would have thought that the cause of the chaos like FuengNakorn would ring the bell in front of his house and ask for the meals cooked by his mother.
title: City of Stars

overview: Departmental midwife Ella and her staff fight a daily battle to give mothers, newborns and relatives the best possible treatment despite strong understaffing. At the same time, she is doing everything she can to suppress her growing feelings for the married pediatrician Jerry.
title: Dag & Nat

overview: Tales of an accomplished sportswriter and womanizer who sometimes confused business and pleasure.
title: Good Time Harry
Saiko no Seito: Yomei Ichinen no Last Dance

overview: A show where if the participants answer incorrectly, it means everything is going as it should. After all, to win, you need to not only know the answers to your questions, but also guess which of your opponents doesn't understand a particular category, and skillfully set them up with a difficult topic. Mean? Yes! But the winner will receive a cash prize. Unless, of course… they set themselves up!
title: Подстава

overview: Hosted by Mike Veerman, Max Kerman and Shane Cunningham, each episode features celeb interviews, candid conversations and personal stories.
title: Mike on Much in Conversation With...

overview: 6 French artists and their teams, made up of young singers, compete in an exceptional show. Each of these teams will be made up of talented children who are fans of an artist. These singers will compete in breathtaking duels, surrounded by children who will all wear the same outfit as their mentor, like "mini-them". And, at the end, only one team and its Mentor will be declared the winner!
title: DreamTeam, la relève des Stars

overview: The Heights centers on a fictional band (also called The Heights) made up of mostly middle-class young adults. Episodes regularly featured one of their songs. The eventual theme song for the show, "How Do You Talk to an Angel" (sung by Walters), went to number one on the Billboard Hot 100 chart, and was the first song from a television show to top the Hot 100 since 1985. The Heights premiered on August 27, 1992, to low ratings, and never gained a substantial audience. Fox canceled the series less than a week after the theme song fell from the number one spot.
title: The Heights

overview: They come from all over France with different backgrounds and ages. They have all had an idea that will perhaps change the daily life of the French, but they all lack crucial elements: support, advice and funding. They will have the unique opportunity to meet six well-known French investors, and will have to convince them to commit to their side.
title: Qui veut être mon associé ?

overview: What is The Inside Man? The Inside Man series started out as a challenge: ‘is it possible to create a drama about information security that rivals anything seen on Netflix?' The result was The Inside Man, Season 1, a twelve episode storyline, featuring Mark, a relatable anti-hero hacker who has been tasked by a sinister ‘controller' to infiltrate a company and help bring it down. Like all the best-loved TV dramas, the key to success was a binge-worthy, gripping storyline with a cast of funny, heroic, resourceful, colorful and skilled characters, whose exploits just had to be reprised for a second and third season. The rest, as they say, is history. The Inside Man ‘family' have now reunited for a fifth season that sees them taking on cyber threats in far-flung parts of the globe. All the adventure, drama and action show no signs of slowing anytime soon. Join us!
title: The Inside Man

overview: Koža is a Serbian television series filmed in 2023 based on a script by Nikola Pejaković and directed by Saša Hajduković. It represents the third and final part of the trilogy about the city of Banja Luka, which comes after the great regional success of the film and the series Meat and Bones.
title: Koža

overview: For 20 years, he gilded world football, Swedish football's greatest player of all time. In eight episodes, we get to follow Zlatan Ibrahimovic's incredible football journey, from his first time in Malmö FF to his farewell in Milan. A fabulous career with 31 international titles, goal record in the national team and a lot of odd press conferences.
title: Historien om Zlatan

overview: The battle of two female characters who challenge each other and are ready to fight. What binds them together in their past?
title: Senden Önce

overview: Five great names from the Brazilian stand up, from different regions of the country, come together to share everyday matters and the particular characteristics of Brazilians in a comical, acidic and fun way.
title: A Culpa é do Cabral

overview: Children's drama series set in a post-apocalytic world where modern technology has collapsed.
title: Maddigan's Quest

overview: A few years after his retirement, Dave Allen is back to share his absurdities on modern life.
title: Dave Allen

overview: Comedic rantings from the Irishman, sitting in his favourite chair with a glass of his favourite drink.
title: Dave Allen Show

overview: 7 episode series. Comedi Dave Allen sits down telling jokes about everyday life and his favourite topic, religion. Filmed in the Mermaid Theatre in London.
title: Dave Allen

overview: In Flip Side two teams of players attempt to determine the sentiments of two distinct groups regarding the same issue. Teams make their selections from multiple-choice answers, and the correct choice secures the pot.
title: Flip Side

overview: Looking for true love, women meet potential husbands while traveling to scenic locales. The catch? Only women can propose, while men are on the clock.
title: Love Deadline

overview: At the end of World War II, young Stan Vandewalle meets boxing trainer Max in a prison camp. Max recognizes Stan's strong left fist as a great boxing talent and becomes his trainer. After the war, Stan lives with his head in the clouds. Until disaster strikes and his gifted younger brother Aloïs dies. As a tribute to his brother who died in an accident, Stan vows to become the greatest boxer in the world.
title: Koning van de Wereld

overview: Peter Goossens is looking for a cook to strengthen his team in his top restaurant 'Hof Van Cleve'. 14 candidates were selected and had to prove by testing and running their own restaurant that they had the talent and perseverance to become a real chef.
title: De Keuken van de Meester

overview: After just one term, the Stratford sisters are making their mark on Padua High. Outspoken Kat is a known campus activist, and she's let down her guard just enough to hook up with mysterious bad boy Patrick. Meanwhile, her social-butterfly sister, Bianca, has taken on self-centered head cheerleader Chastity, and just might be dating her ex, would-be male model Joey... much to the sorrow of love-struck nerd Cameron. Things just keep getting more interesting as these changes rock Padua's social order. Meanwhile, back at home, overprotective Dr. Stratford is NOT happy about this boy invasion, but he has ways of keeping his girls in line.
title: 10 Things I Hate About You

overview: Guy Martin takes part in an epic 1000-mile trip across India, finishing it by taking part in one of the world's craziest bike races. Gup hopes to win it at the end of his two-week trip.
title: Our Guy in India

overview: Bad Romance reports on "20/20" stories ripped from the headlines, leading viewers through some of the most shocking and surprising romance stories of the last decade — stories that began with romance and ended in crime.
title: Bad Romance

overview: In 1991, Greek politician Makis Metaxas discovered a 3000-year-old tomb on Kefalonia, unearthing an object resembling a possession of King Odysseus. This is the story of how this tomb was found.
title: Odysseus Returns

overview: Super Rich in Korea unveils a realm where luxury cars and haute couture are everyday sights, and exclusive parties are the norm. It's a deep dive into a lifestyle where wealth meets Korean cultural flair.
title: Super Rich in Korea

overview: Follow the lives of a group of students and teachers of an imaginary high school. It shows the rivalries between the volleyball club and the song-and-dance group. It deals with important subjects like forbidden student/teacher affairs, coming out, and drug abuse, with help from songs that can be affronted and overtaken.
title: Hand aufs Herz

overview: In Co-Dependents, a 30-something brother and sister have gotten older but haven't really grown up. Childhood rituals and their commitment to each other always take first place over spouses, jobs and kids.
title: Co-Dependents

overview: Eleven years ago Detective Kat Donovan's fiancé Josh – the love of her life – disappeared and she's never heard from him since. Now, swiping profiles on a dating app, she suddenly sees his face and her world explodes all over again. Josh's reappearance will force her to dive back into the mystery surrounding her father's murder and uncover long-buried secrets from her past.
title: Harlan Coben's Missing You

overview: Garth Barnard has a lifelong passion and unshakeable resolve to investigate how thousands of young Airmen from the Second World War died in catastrophic air accidents and training crashes.
title: WWII Air Crash Detectives

overview: Simon had the perfect life: loving wife and kids, great job, beautiful home. But then his eldest daughter Paige ran away and everything fell apart. So now when he finds her, vulnerable and strung out on drugs in a city park, he finally has the chance to bring his little girl home. But it turns out she's not alone and an argument escalates into shocking violence that will shatter Simon's life all over again. His search for his daughter will take him into a dangerous underworld, revealing deep secrets that could tear his family apart forever.
title: Harlan Coben's Run Away

overview: True Crime News will cover breaking crime news and updates on crime stories.
title: True Crime News

overview: Round by round, match by match, the best rugby teams in Europe battle it out to take home the trophy in the 2023 Guinness Six Nations Championship.
title: Six Nations: Full Contact

overview: Outside the supermarket with her young son, Cathy encounters Michael - the man convicted of the brutal murder of her brother, 20 years earlier. Ignoring the advice of her best friend, Cathy takes to social media, uncovering the successful career and family life Michael has forged for himself since early release from prison, while she grieved for her brother. Re-traumatised by her past, Cathy instigates a clandestine relationship with the man she despises, embarking on a campaign of harassment and deceit. As Cathy's obsession grows, dark fantasies of revenge and reality blur as she sets out on a campaign of psychological warfare to destroy Michael's life.
title: Dead and Buried

overview: Crongton chronicles the lives and journeys of a group of young people living in a thriving, multicultural community in a fictional urban housing estate, as they navigate the complexities of social politics, peer pressure and identity while trying to forge a place for themselves within a world full of possibility and littered with danger. Shot through with irreverent humour and featuring animated fantasy sequences, it's a joyful, energetic ride through the trials and tribulations of growing up, a celebration of the kind of community you only find on an estate, and a look at how you come to terms with the darkness of the world around you when you're on the cusp of childhood and adulthood.
title: Crongton

overview: Love with a capital L. Everyone dreams about it, but finding it isn't that simple. The search for a bride or groom through the worldwide web and is therefore becoming increasingly popular. The brand new VT4 Exotic Love program shows that the search for a partner beyond the borders of the country, is not always evident.
title: Exotische Liefde

overview: Forty years after, through the eyes of those directly involved, this powerful series explores the bitterly divisive strike that wounded the soul of the nation.
title: The Miners' Strike 1984: The Battle for Britain

overview: The series follows the inspiring journey of newly cancer-free teen Louise Edgar as she embarks on a mission to make up for lost time, completing the items on her ‘Live Large List'. With the help of her new pal and school outsider, Jess, Louise starts to tackle her list one item at a time and, whether experiencing triumphs or setbacks, she truly starts to live large.
title: Louise Lives Large

overview: Vivid, gritty and stylish drama set in vice-ridden Georgian London. A stellar cast headed by Ian McDiarmid and Iain Glen brings to life the story behind the birth of the modern police force.
title: City of Vice

overview: When Josh's fiancé leaves him for a new guy he finds himself shattered – and in need of a new place to live. He ends up moving in with Rex and Connor, a mysterious pair. He quickly becomes intrigued by their late-night excursions. Encouraged to live a little, he joins them on an outing – and the night proves more exciting that he could have imagined. Crime doesn't pay… but revenge does.
title: Peckham Mix

overview: When Bahar comes face to face with death, she will encounter another face of her family, especially her husband Timur, who seems 'perfect' from the outside. With Bahar's sudden illness, all dynamics in the family will change. In this process, Evren will be Timur's rival in every sense. Bahar's reconstruction of her life will instill hope in the audience, often with tragicomic stories.
title: Bahar

overview: Newly ascended to fame, young rock stars must not only go on a national tour, but also write new songs and be able to stay on the wave of popularity, otherwise the label will take away all rights to their music.
title: Tea Time

overview: Due to government shuffle during the reign of Wu Zetian, the ambitious Di Renjie was relegated to a remote town in the east. Di showed extraordinary talent in case-solving, but as he probed further, more and more secrets were revealed. He embarked on a nationwide journey and solved many mysterious cases. In the end, he returned to Chang'an and reunited with his father. Together, they tackled a crisis that threatened peace and order.
title: Judge Dee's Mystery

overview: Mari is a seemingly ordinary girl who, while sleeping, incorporates spirits thirsty to resolve earthly issues. To try to deal with this situation, she hires a psychologist to... treat the spirits!
title: A Mensageira

overview: Following a tragic car accident, two childhood friends were separated. Many years later, they reunited as foster siblings. They probed and tested each other, navigating through the maze of love and potential family feuds. After many hardships, they worked together to uncover the truth behind the fateful accident. They then lived happily ever after.
title: Indulgence

overview: Three-part biopic of the Liverpudlian songbird who would later find fame and fortune. It tells of her rocky road to fame and captures the essence of 1960s Liverpool.
title: Cilla

overview: Apartment404 is a real-life mystery drama based on true unprecedented events in Korean apartments. Six residents get invited to a secret-filled apartment, where they face mysteries and solve secrets. Get ready for retro vibes, laughter, the residents' fantastic chemistry, and intrigue, as the residents travel to a different time in each episode! What will happen on Apartment404?
title: Apartment404

overview: Adam is a charismatic tutor who charms his way into the life of the wealthy Tanner family while they're on holiday in Greece. When the family's nanny falls dangerously ill, Adam orchestrates his way in to their London home and his true vengeful nature begins to emerge... Adam now starts to turn Jamie Tanner and Nat against each other and secretly plots to bring down the entire family. When Adam's obsession with the family raises questions, those who dig deeper into his past find themselves playing a dangerous game. With his world collapsing around him, Jamie starts to realise that Adam may be responsible for all their recent disasters - but is it too late to save his family? In this revenge thriller that proves the past never stays buried, one question remains: how do you protect your family from the enemy within.
title: Malice

overview: A Canada-United Kingdom co-production produced in association with Bloomberg Media, the series follows the Emmy® nominated actor and Goodwill Ambassador for the UN Development Program as he journeys around the world, discovering innovative and inspiring initiatives that could help the Earth. With an emphasis on transforming environmental pessimism into hope, climate angst into optimism, and human disconnection into engagement, An Optimist's Guide to the Planet captures Coster-Waldau's world-wide search for people-led ideas, traditions, and attitudes helping drive humanity toward a brighter, more sustainable future. The series travels to countries including Greenland, Australia, Mexico, Vietnam, Germany, The United States, The Netherlands, Spain, Japan, St. Vincent, Vietnam, and Kenya, uncovering initiatives such as sustainable food growth, carbon neutral jet fuel, tiny worms that can break down plastics, and more. Each episode of the series is structured as an organic exploration focused on a broad theme – Shelter, Regenerate, Nourish, Move, and Transform. Covering three to four different stories, characters, and cultures per episode, the series premiere, Dusk or Dawn, explores the difference between the coming of darkness and the beginning of new light in locations Greenland, Australia, The United States, and Japan.
title: An Optimist's Guide to the Planet with Nikolaj Coster-Waldau

overview: One year after the hospital occupation incident, Saburo Musashi of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police Investigation Division has another "worst day" ...! Kanagawa Prefecture's first international airport "Kanagawa New Airport" is suddenly occupied by an armed group wearing a beast mask!
title: Shin Kuukou Senkyo

overview: Talented designers explore how a series of small decisions come together to reveal a beautiful story within a space.
title: Well Designed

overview: After an accident, Motomiya Yuri can hear other people's inner voices when she looks into their eyes. Due to these telepathic abilities, Yuri hears people's true feelings that she does not want to know, and she often gets hurt in secret. She becomes afraid of knowing other people's true feelings, and she becomes afraid of showing her true feelings to others as well. She does not get close to people if not necessary and gave up on falling in love. One day, Yuri meets Yoon Tae Oh, a younger Korean student. Tae Oh has a bright and friendly personality and is loved by everyone around him due to his innocence. He is straightforward and extremely pure when it comes to love. When she happens to make eye contact with him, she hears his inner thoughts and voice, but in Korean! With Tae Oh she starts to think that the love she had given up on might still be possible. Will Tae Oh's bright and straightforward presence melt Yuri's closed heart, which is unable to reveal her true feelings?
title: Eye Love You

overview: A modern female forensic doctor is reborn as a murderer in ancient times? Watch Mo Linlang, the guilty maid, make a shocking counterattack, use modern technology to cleverly solve strange cases, and fight side by side with Prince He Yijing to save each other.
title: All I See is You

overview: Jiang Jie is a talented young chef whose knife skills and cooking abilities have led him to the very pinnacle of traditional Chinese cuisine. His skills have landed him the coveted Five-Star Kitchen Knife, the ultimate prize for the nation's cooks. He now works in a top-end hotel. But he secretly hungers for a showdown against an older chef whose skills are still legendary. Meanwhile, that same older chef's young female apprentice, Li Nai, is hoping to help restore her master's honor. She hatches a plan that involves landing a job in the hotel's kitchen...so she can infiltrate Jiang Jie's inner circle. But, little does she know that Jiang Jie also has a cunning plan to prove once and for all that he is peerless when it comes to Chinese cuisine! Who will win this battle of wits, hearts, and culinary wizardry?
title: Sweet Trap

overview: Sir David Attenborough charts the story of animals who defy gravity in this dazzling documentary.
title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies

overview: Benoît is the head of BG Immo, a small real estate agency in Puteaux. Benoît is unwavering in his positivity and future success. But his agency's accounts are in the red. He must react and has decided to modernize his sales and communication methods. And for this he will follow the teachings of his master of living and thinking: Stéphane Plaza.
title: Benoît Gênant Officiel

overview: Five friends spend the night together before a momentous event. What they don't know is that one of them has a big announcement to make to them...
title: Enterrement de Vie de Garçon

overview: Wrongly accused of killing another child and avoiding the colony, twelve-year-old Matas runs away from the orphanage. He is joined by ten-year-old Guste, who has become an accomplice in the escape. Pretending to be brother and sister Saukos, the children live in one of the biggest garbage dumps in Lithuania. In it, hunger, exploitation, violence and inevitable death await them. Matas creates a plan to escape, but fate prepares unpleasant surprises to stop them... The series are based on the motifs of the famous novel by E. Malukas "People of the Dump", which shocks from the first shots.
title: Siukslyno Zmones

overview: The Money Game follows, in real time, a historic turning point in the NCAA upon policy changes on name, image, and likeness (NIL) rights—guaranteed to shape the trajectory of college sports forever—highlighted by the surreal experiences of LSU's top players, coaches, and administrators. LSU, the flagship university of the state of Louisiana, is one of the most iconic brands in college athletics. LSU boasts an SEC-best 51 team national championships and is currently home to three of the top-10 collegiate earners in NIL.
title: The Money Game

overview: Katya, hiding from the problems that her brother "threw" at her, gets a job living in a mansion on Rublevka. In a huge estate, behind a high fence, oligarch Sergei gathers the whole family under one roof — his real, third wife and their children together, as well as two ex-wives and children from previous marriages, to announce to them that he is terminally ill and "has not long to live." The ex-wives are already mentally dividing the inheritance, Katya gets closer to the eldest son of the owner of the mansion, Misha, who pretends to be an employee of the estate. His eldest daughter Olya, who is acutely worried about the forced return to Moscow from a warm country, finds support in the person of her new driver. And the numerous service staff not only watches the lives of amazingly rich people whose bags cost the same as their mortgages, but also does not stay away from a lot of intrigues.
title: Бедные смеются, богатые плачут
